name: Anhelo
description: Anhelo is a vampire assassin and museum keeper of New Capenna's Maestros family, Xander's deputy and heir, and the father of Errant.

description_citations.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

summary.text: Anhelo is a vampire assassin and museum keeper of New Capenna's Maestros family, Xander's deputy and heir, and the father of Errant.

bio.text: Xander sired him and sent him to spy on the Cabaretti's rumored new Halo supply, and he recruited Elspeth into the Maestros and took her to the family museum.

citations.text: "Vampire", section "Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fiero Vespin attacks Parnesse before her rehearsal dinner, breaking her ribs; she refuses to tell Errant.
timeline.quote: Fiero attacked Parnesse before their rehearsal dinner, leaving Parnesse with broken ribs and smelling of blood.

citation.text: "Parnesse", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xander measures Anhelo for a new outfit and shares worries about Halo supply.
timeline.quote: "The balance of power in this town is shifting."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander orders Anhelo to secretly learn about the Cabaretti's rumored new Halo supply in the Mezzio.
timeline.quote: gather the information on what this source is by whatever means necessary.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo applauds, offers Elspeth work with the Maestros and mentions Halo.
timeline.quote: Why don't you start with the Maestros?

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo shows Elspeth a fountain statue of an angel fighting a spined creature, which Elspeth recognizes as a Phyrexian.
timeline.quote: Anhelo might not know what it was, but she certainly did.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth reluctantly accepts the Maestros' offer to gain information on the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: "All right," Elspeth reluctantly agreed.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien sees a woman fight off Maestro enforcers in the street and then watches her give her name to the vampire Anhelo.
timeline.quote: The woman ignored the gesture, continuing to walk before she said, "Elspeth."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo takes Elspeth to the Maestros' museum after she agrees to join the family.
timeline.quote: Anhelo had taken her right to the Maestros' museum after Elspeth had agreed to join the family

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: On the eve of the Crescendo, Xander walks the museum one last time, names Anhelo his heir and orders him to go to the Crescendo in his place.
timeline.quote: "But someday soon, you will be."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander sends Anhelo out the receiving door, sensing enemies are close, and then confronts the Adversary in the shadows.
timeline.quote: "Have you finally come to kill me, Adversary?"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: On the eve of his daughter's wedding, Anhelo takes Errant to a rundown neighborhood to buy information from Toluz.
timeline.quote: "Art's everywhere, if you know where to look,"

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Toluz agrees to tell Anhelo about the woman in white only if he kills Fiero Vespin, who has attacked her daughter Parnesse, by tomorrow's wedding.
timeline.quote: "If you want information for your Family, you have to do a little work for ours. Bump him off, and we'll talk,"

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Toluz reveals Fiero plans to use twenty goons to ruin the wedding, and Anhelo accepts the job.
timeline.quote: "Real considerate of you," he said.

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo sends Fiero an invitation to a private museum tour and asks Evelyn for a favor, agreeing to owe her.
timeline.quote: "All right," he said. "Name your price."

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo gives Fiero a private tour of the museum, flattering him through the exhibits to the Old Capenna exhibit.
timeline.quote: "Welcome to the Old Capenna exhibit."

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo tricks Fiero into standing in a spot where he cuts a wire and the Old Capennan Warrior's axe beheads him, leaving a warning in blood: death to traitors.
timeline.quote: Fiero's head came clean off.

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Running late to the wedding, Anhelo takes a cab driven by a man who locks the doors and takes him on a reckless drive.
timeline.quote: the locks clamped down on the doors.

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: The driver reveals he is Severo, whose father Anhelo killed on his birthday three years ago, and drives into oncoming traffic.
timeline.quote: "It's Severo. And three years ago, you killed my father on my birthday,"

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: A Riveteer transport crashes into the car; Anhelo stabs Severo and survives the wreck.
timeline.quote: A huge Riveteer transport crashed into them like an angry rhox.

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Riveteers who own the Halo in the trunk surround the battered Anhelo, who resolves to fight his way to the wedding.
timeline.quote: "You want to dance?" he slurred.

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Toluz appears with the shadow generator's darkness and wipes out the Riveteers, saving Anhelo.
timeline.quote: When it was all over, she was the only one left standing

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Toluz calls Anhelo family and has a healer and a new suit waiting for him in her limo.
timeline.quote: "You're family, Anhelo."

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo and Toluz arrive at Grand Capenna Hall, where Toluz offers him information free in the future and he declines.
timeline.quote: We can leave business for some other day."

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo dismisses a lackey reporting lost men at the Caldaia, saying the only family he cares about is in the bridal suite.
timeline.quote: the only family I care about is in that room.

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo reaches the bridal suite in time and is reunited with Errant on her wedding day.
timeline.quote: "Daddy! Daddy, you're here!"

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo gives Elspeth and Vivien Xander's letter naming him successor and granting Elspeth access to the archives.
timeline.quote: The Maestros are now in your hands

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth routs Maestros enforcers and is invited to join the family by Anhelo.
timeline.quote: Dispatching the thugs, Elspeth was approached by Anhelo, the Maestros' vampire lieutenant, who invited her to join the family.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xander founds the Maestros and becomes New Capenna's first vampire, siring Evelyn and Anhelo.
timeline.quote: Xander, founder and head of the Maestros, was the first vampire, and his first progeny was Evelyn .

citation.text: "Vampire", section "Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a dream-memory of her wedding, Errant and Parnesse dance among the Maestros until Phyrexian oil transforms the guests, including her father Anhelo, and Atraxa tears off the roof.
timeline.quote: the roof of the Maestro's museum was ripped clean off

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Errant places the charges in the city's core and finds her Phyrexianized father Anhelo blocking her way.
timeline.quote: Her father stood before her.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Anhelo tries to persuade Errant to join New Phyrexia, and she argues beauty is mess and experimentation.
timeline.quote: "Beauty isn't found by coloring in the lines.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Della's Halo signal shows Atraxa is in position; Errant says goodbye to her father and detonates the core, collapsing Park Heights.
timeline.quote: The core above her burst with orange flame and smoke.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Atraxa and ten thousand soldiers invade; the Phyrexians compleat the Maestros' leadership including Anhelo.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians compleated the Maestros' leadership, including Anhelo .

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "New Phyrexia's Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anhelo kills Severo Sr.; Severo Jr. lures him into a cab on Errant's wedding day and sets him up with stolen Halo.
timeline.quote: he killed Severo Sr. .

citation.text: "Anhelo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Xander's death in the Cabaretti Crescendo, Anhelo is promoted.
timeline.quote: he was promoted after his boss's death during the Cabaretti Crescendo .

citation.text: "Anhelo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anhelo is compleated, faces Errant to stop her from blowing up Park Heights, fails and dies in the explosion.
timeline.quote: He failed and died in the explosion.

citation.text: "Anhelo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xander wills control of the Maestros to his deputy Anhelo.
timeline.quote: He willed control of the Maestros to his deputy, Anhelo .

citation.text: "Xander", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Tries to hurt Anhelo's daughter's wedding day to avenge his father.
relations.quote: Hope your daughter hurts like I did.

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

relations.quote: Even her father, Anhelo, had been transformed.
